config.label: URL of the BlackLake API the bridge forwards to
config.description: URL of the BlackLake API the bridge forwards to. Defaults to http://localhost:3100 (the address npx blacklake serve listens on).

config.label: Bearer <your BlackLake API key>
config.description: Bearer <your BlackLake API key>. Create a key at https://console.blacklake.systems (free while in beta). Per-upstream gateway paths live at /mcp/u/<upstream-id>.
